description: Every GA4 property the caller's connected Google Analytics grant can access — the data source for picking which property to bind to a project (see set_ga4_property). Live call to the Analytics Admin API (accountSummaries.list), not an archive read. Read-only and FREE (no credits). Check `requiresReconnect` before treating an empty `properties` list as 'no properties': true means the stored grant can no longer reach Google Analytics.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_ga4_properties
